db02AuditPass.evidenceNature: Source JPA field annotations plus precomputed historical DDL inventory and latest available committed Drizzle snapshot. No live DB introspection, API/runtime proof, migration replay or executed tests.
priorityGaps: Semester and semester_course have no verified program-specific persisted equivalent; academic_periods is college-scoped. Preserve semester name/ordinal and course order/credits/mandatory flag.
Lecture_hall has no observed room entity; section_schedule_events.location cannot enforce hall FK, capacity, room type or collision.
Class GROUP_BACKED/roster_group_id and lower_limit are absent from sections; group roster linkage and tenant consistency require explicit relation.
Class_schedule time strings, faculty/course/room references and attendance_marked_at are not one-to-one with section_schedule_events and attendance_sessions.
Faculty course association versus class-scoped assignment, semester-specific teaching, enable/disable and audit history require producer/consumer comparison.
Legacy new_program.duration_years versus programs.duration_terms needs explicit conversion decision and proof; older program and structure tables need active/retired review.
Batch academic_year/current_semester/current_students/start/end cannot be presumed derivable from cohort references and enrollment counts without parity proof.
Temporal state transitions, soft deletion, actor-scoped ACL/tenancy and multi-tenant FK relationships lack disposable PostgreSQL verification.
followUpEvidenceRequired: Read academic setup and timetable service/endpoint writes against pinned and newest backend/FE source SHAs; classify each unconfirmed field as active, retired or calculated
Review 13 legacy tables and all 125 fields with explicit row-level semantic decision, source producer/consumer and constraint/FK/deletion evidence
Draft additions to domain-owned schemas or isolated SQL staging only; Chat 1 exclusively registers shared migrations and barrel
Execute zero-to-current migration replay and academic negative integration tests with disposable PostgreSQL; record exact SHAs and run IDs
